releases.notes:
## 1.7.1 - Minecraft 26.1.2 - 26.3

### New: Global preset
- A globe toggle next to the multiplayer sync (compass) icon applies your current preset to every player you see
- Off by default (`globalPresetEnabled` in `config/hidearmor.json`)
- Mobs and armor stands are untouched - the override only applies while a player is being rendered

### Downloads
Each jar is universal (Fabric + NeoForge in one file):

| Jar | Minecraft |
| --- | --- |
| `HideYourArmor-1.7.1+mc26.1.2-universal.jar` | 26.1.2, 26.1.x and 26.2 |
| `HideYourArmor-1.7.1+mc26.3-universal.jar` | 26.3 |

26.3 reworked the render submit pipeline (`SubmitNodeCollection`, `ItemInHandRenderer` -> `FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRenderer`, SDL3 input), so it needs its own jar.

### Fixed
- Shield transparency mixin crash: a non-private static `ThreadLocal` was rejected during mixin APPLY
- `RenderSetupAccessor` overwrote vanilla `RenderSetup.getTextures()` with the raw `TextureBinding` map, crashing `RenderType.draw` with a `ClassCastException`
- Removed the unused render accessors entirely

### Notes
- Client-side only; multiplayer sync remains optional
- Both jars verified with `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`

releases.notes:
## 1.7.0 – Minecraft 26.3 "Wilderness Bound"

### Port
- MC `26.2` → `26.3` (`gradle.properties:6`), NeoForge `26.2.0.8-beta` → `26.3.0.10-beta`, Fabric API `0.153.0+26.2` → `0.161.0+26.3`, loader `0.19.3` → `0.19.5`, Architectury `21.0.2` → `22.0.2`, Loom `1.14` → `1.17` (1.14 can't read 26.3's class-tweaker v2 format), WGFM `Beta.4+26.2` → `Beta.5+mc26.3-fabric`
- Metadata ranges → `[26.3,)` (`fabric.mod.json:19`, `neoforge.mods.toml:18,25`)

### Fixed
- Crash on world join: `Mixin transformation of SubmitNodeCollection failed` / `wrapModelSubmit (0/1) succeeded` – 26.3 routes translucent submits through `FeatureRenderPhase.submit(SubmitNode)`, not `TranslucentFeatureRenderPhase.submit(TranslucentSubmit)` (`ShieldTransparencyMixin.java:38`)
- Shield pop-in above 0%: 26.3 shield submits use sprite-backed cutout types via `SpriteId.renderType(Function)` and never call `Model.renderType(Identifier)`, so the old swap never fired and alpha was ignored. Non-glint `ShieldModel` submits now swap to `entityTranslucent` shield atlas where alpha is patched (`ShieldTransparencyMixin.java:63`)
- Keybinds: `org.lwjgl.glfw` removed (GLFW → SDL3), `InputConstants.Type.KEYSYM` gone – both clients now use `InputConstants.KEY_H` + `KeyMapping(String, int, Category)` (`HideArmorFabricClient.java:34`, `NeoForgeClientHandler.java:22`)

### 26.3 render changes adapted
- `RenderTypes.armorTranslucent` / `Sheets.ARMOR_TRIMS_SHEET` deleted → `entityTranslucent(texture)` / `armorTrim(Identifier, boolean)`; trim submits tagged via `ThreadLocal` (`EquipmentRendererMixin.java:105`)
- `submitModel` 10-arg → 9-arg (`..., tintedColor, UvMapping, outlineColor`), `TextureAtlasSprite` → `UvMapping` (`EquipmentRendererMixin.java:130`, `CapeRendererMixin.java:43`)
- `ItemInHandRenderer` deleted → `FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRenderer.submitArmWithItem` (`HeldItemRendererMixin.java:16`)
- `VertexConsumer.setUv3` now abstract (`AlphaVertexConsumer.java:5`)
- WGFM Beta.5 breaking changes: `com.wildfire.*` → `com.wildfire.client.*`, `GenderArmorLayer` rewritten onto vanilla `EquipmentLayerRenderer` pipeline – deleted obsolete `WGFMGenderArmorLayerMixin.java` (breast armor now covered by `EquipmentRendererMixin`), retargeted `BreastPhysicsCompatMixin` / `WGFMGenderLayerMixin` (both `tightness()` call sites still present in Beta.5)

### Notes
- Skulls/blocks still hide at 0% only (binary), everything else fades 0–100%
- 26.2 remains available via tag `v1.6.1`
- Verified `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`, `HideYourArmor-1.7.0-universal.jar`

releases.notes:
## 1.6.1

### Fixed
- #4 Elytra is affected by chestplate opacity setting independently of Elytra visibility setting – chestplate slider was bleeding into elytra (same equipment slot). Now elytra has its own independent opacity in `EquipmentRendererMixin.java:50` (`cfg.elytraOpacity`)
- #5 Mod needed serverside but crashes when on it
  - Dedicated server crash `NoClassDefFoundError: net/minecraft/client/gui/screens/Screen at HideArmorNeoForge.<init>:19` – client init was loaded on servers. Now guarded via reflection in `HideArmorNeoForge.java:13` → `HideArmorNeoForgeClient.java:1`
  - `Connection Lost: Channel hidearmor:sync missing on server side, but required on client!` – made payload optional in `HideArmorNeoForge.java:42` (`event.registrar("1").optional().playBidirectional(...)`)
  - `Cannot register payload hidearmor:sync as it is already registered` – switched from separate `playToServer` + `playToClient` to single `playBidirectional`
  - `UnsupportedOperationException: Payload hidearmor:sync may not be sent to the server!` on vanilla servers – added `hasChannel` guard in `NeoForgeClientHandler.java:57` and `canSend` guard in `HideArmorFabricClient.java:61`
- Black screen + spam `Entity renderers map is empty, will retry later` – cape mixin targeted `OrderedSubmitNodeCollector/IIII` with 0 hits. Fixed `CapeRendererMixin.java:43` to `SubmitNodeCollector/III` (verified via `javap -c CapeLayer` on `minecraft-merged-043a8b3edf-26.2.jar`)

### Transparency
- Restored gradual opacity: Elytra (per-player `cfg.elytraOpacity`) and Cape (`RenderTypes.entityTranslucent` + `ARGB.color(alpha,255,255,255)`) + Trim (`armorTranslucent`). Skulls/blocks remain hide at 0% (binary) to avoid fragile `SkullBlockRenderer` mixin.
- Verified `BUILD SUCCESSFUL` + `build/universal/HideYourArmor-1.6.1-universal.jar`

releases.notes:
# Hide Your Armor 1.5.4

## New Features
- **Presets**: Save and load armor visibility configurations. Create named presets via the new strip above the GUI. Default presets: "Full Visibility" and "Invisible" (cannot be deleted).
- **Smooth Hotbar Animation**: Blocking overlay now scales proportionally with shield opacity instead of binary on/off.
- **FemaleGenderMod Compatibility**: Breast size no longer shrinks when chestplate opacity is set to 0%.
- **Multiplayer Sync**: Config now broadcasts periodically (every 5s) so late joiners receive other players' settings.

## Bug Fixes
- WGFM breast armor and skin layer now respect other players' opacity settings in multiplayer.
